EXAM: ULTRASOUND GUIDED CORE NEEDLE BIOPSY OF TWO SITES IN THE RIGHT BREAST AND ONE SITE IN THE LEFT BREAST FOLLOWED BY CLIP PLACEMENT
EXAM: DIAGNOSTIC BILATERAL MAMMOGRAM WITH ICAD

History: This is followup to the mammogram and sonogram of [REDACTED]

Technique: An initial targeted ultrasound was performed using a high frequency linear transducer.

Within the right retroareolar region, a lobulated irregular mass measures 1.8 cm. At the right 11 o'clock axis perpendicular region, a lobulated soft tissue nodule measures 1.0 cm. At the left 2 o'clock axis, 5 cm from the nipple, a hypoechoic nodule measures 0.6 cm.

Consent: The patient [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] and alternative to the procedure. The risks include infection, bleeding. Informed consent was given by the patient.

Procedure: Both breasts was prepped and draped in the usual sterile fashion. 1% lidocaine was used to infiltrate the skin and subcutaneous tissues.

Under ultrasound guidance, a core needle biopsy was performed upon the right retroareolar nodule. A marker was deployed.

Under ultrasound guidance, a core needle biopsy was performed upon the right 11 o'clock nodule. Marker was then deployed.

Under ultrasound guidance, fine needle aspiration/core needle biopsy was performed upon the 0.6 left 2 o'clock nodule. A marker was then deployed.

The patient [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] and did not reveal a hematoma. The samples were submitted to CBL pathology laboratories for further evaluation.

Bilateral diagnostic MLO and Craniocaudal views were performed that demonstrate bilateral markers with postbiopsy changes.

IMPRESSION:

STATUS POST ULTRASOUND GUIDED BIOPSY OF RIGHT RETROAREOLAR IRREGULAR NODULE, RIGHT 11 O'CLOCK NODULE AND LEFT 2 O'CLOCK NODULE.

EXAM: DIGITAL BILATERAL DIAGNOSTIC MAMMOGRAM
EXAM: BILATERAL BREAST ULTRASOUND

History: Palpable lump in the upper outer right breast. No [REDACTED]

Technique: Bilateral MLO and Craniocaudal mammographic views were performed using digital technique.

Findings: The breast parenchyma is heterogeneously dense, 50 to 75% fibroglandular, lowering the sensitivity of the study. Palpable nodule in the upper outer periareolar right breast was marked with a marker. Spot compression over this region demonstrates several ill defined nodular densities measuring 1.5 cm or smaller. These are irregular. Nodularity is also seen in the upper outer right breast. Within the left breast, mild nodularity is seen in the upper outer left breast. No [REDACTED]

Sonographic evaluation of both breasts was performed using a high frequency linear transducer. All four quadrants, retroareolar regions and axillae were evaluated bilaterally.

The breast parenchyma is heterogeneously dense. Within the right breast, at the 10 o'clock retroareolar region, a lobulated irregular mass measures 1.6 x 1.4 x 1.8 cm corresponding to the palpable lump. An adjacent irregular nodule at 9 o'clock measures 0.7 x 0.7 x 0.6 cm. At the right 11 o'clock periareolar region, a lobulated nodule measures 1.0 x 1.0 x 0.8 cm. Right axillary lymph nodes are seen demonstrating thickened cortex. Within the left breast, an ill defined nodule at the 2 o'clock axis measures 0.7 x 0.6 x 0.6 cm. Benign appearing lymph nodes are seen in the left axilla.

IMPRESSION:

PALPABLE LUMP IN THE RIGHT RETROAREOLAR REGION CORRESPONDS TO 1.8 CM IRREGULAR SOLID MASS. AN ADDITIONAL 1.0 CM SOLID MASS IS ALSO SEEN AS WELL AS RIGHT 11 O'CLOCK 1.0 CM SOLID MASS. THESE ARE ALL SUSPICIOUS. THE LEFT BREAST 0.7 CM ILL DEFINED NODULE IS ALSO SEEN AT THE LEFT BREAST 2 O'CLOCK POSITION THAT IS ALSO SUSPICIOUS. LYMPH NODES IN THE RIGHT AXILLA ALSO SEEN THAT ARE ALSO INDETERMINATE. RECOMMEND FURTHER EVALUATION WITH ULTRASOUND GUIDED CORE NEEDLE BIOPSY OF BOTH BREASTS. BILATERAL BREAST MRI WITH CONTRAST ENHANCEMENT IS ALSO RECOMMENDED.

BI-RADS CATEGORY SLIGHTLY SUGGESTIVE OF MALIGNANCY-APPROPRIATE ACTION SHOULD BE TAKEN)

THE RESULTS WERE REPORTED TO RADA AT DR TRAKHTENBERG'S OFFICE ON [REDACTED]

*The Ventana Pathway anti-HER2/neu (4B5) is a semi-quantitative
immunohistochemical assay to determine HER2/neu over-expression in
breast cancer tissues routinely processed for histologic evaluation.
This test has been approved by the FDA as an aid in the assessment of
patients for whom trastuzumab (Herceptin) treatment is being
considered. The kit used in this staining has been FDA approved for
breast and gastric cancers. As with any IHC type assay, a false
negative result is possible. A negative result does not exclude the
possibility of HER2/neu over-expression and clinically warranted,
more sensitive DNA based methodology (i.e. FISH) for evaluating gene
amplification may be indicated.

This assay is performed in concordance with CAP/ASCO criteria. The
results of this test are altered/affected by variables beyond our
laboratory's control, e.g. fixatives other than formalin and fixation
times other than those recommended in the CAP/ASCO guidelines. The
reporting ranges have been modified from the original FDA approved
reporting criteria to reflect those recommended in the updated
CAP/ASCO guidelines. This test is not intended as a confirmation of
the original diagnosis and should be used in conjunction with other
established risk factors, clinical and diagnostic procedures.

Patients with breast cancers that are HER2 IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH
amplified may be eligible for several therapies in that category HER2
signaling positive invasive breast cancers that test "HER2-Negative"
(IHC 0, 1+ or 2+/ISH not-amplified) are more specifically considered
"HER2-negative for protein overexpression/gene amplification" since
non-overexpressed levels of the HER2 protein may be present in these
cases. Patients with breast cancers that are HER2 IHC 0 (incomplete
faint membrane staining within <10% of the tumor cells), 1+, or
IHC 2+/ISH not amplified may be eligible for a treatment that targets
non-amplified/non-overexpressed levels of HER2 expression for
cytotoxic drug delivery.

HER2 Reporting Guidelines per ASCO and CAP:
Negative (Score 0): No [REDACTED]

cells.
Negative (Score1+): Incomplete membrane staining that is faint/barely
perceptible and within >10% of tumor cells.
Equivocal (Score2+): Weak to moderate complete membrane staining in
>10% of tumor cells or Complete membrane staining that is intense but
within </=10% of tumor cells.
Positive (Score 3+): Complete membrane staining that is intense and
>10% of tumor cells.
